evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: This requests one feature (create a game) with enumerated attributes (name, optional description), not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: inviting estimators via a URL; not combining independent features.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: starting a round via entering an item; no independent features combined.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the list of items for the session.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item (including re-selection) is one feature, not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding an item to the estimate list.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: editing an item; not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting an item from the list.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: immediately revealing estimates; the rationale clause is not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accepting the average as the agreed estimate.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: One feature with a conditional behavior (auto-fill); not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: entering the agreed estimate.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: re-estimating a previously estimated story.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: importing stories from a spreadsheet file.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: a clipboard-based import method; an alternate approach to PP-014 but itself atomic.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: browsing previous games.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing a game's transcript.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: exporting transcript to HTML (specific format is an attribute, not a separate feature).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: exporting transcript to CSV; format enumeration is an attribute.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting a game and its stored data.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account creation with enumerated input fields (attributes), not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: login using credentials.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: updating account details.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account deletion (and associated data removal).

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: local timezone display for dates/times.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: password reminder via email.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: choosing an estimation scale (enumerated options are attributes), not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: inviting estimators with a specified limit.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: joining a game via the provided URL and entering a name.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the current item under estimation.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing all upcoming items for the session.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: immediately indicating which estimator has submitted an estimate.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: simultaneous reveal of estimates once all have submitted.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allowing estimate changes until draw completion; conditional timing is part of the one feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing prior estimates per estimator for the current story.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying which participant gave each estimate in the round.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: a shared two-minute countdown timer visible to participants.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automatic reset behavior of the timer; a property of the timer feature rather than another independent feature.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: scrolling back through past stories and estimates.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: consistent card ordering across draws (an attribute of the UI), not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allowing estimate changes before draw completion; similar to other timing-based estimate-change stories.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: display a thumbnail near the player's cards for personalization.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: achieving standards compliance (listing multiple standards is attribute enumeration).

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: providing a glossary of terms.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding database indexes to improve query performance.

evaluations.evidence: have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: cross-browser compatibility requirement; enumerating target browsers are attributes of the single compatibility feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accessibility compliance (guideline adherence is an attribute), not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: improving application responsiveness.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: Unicode support for international text.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: having sensible, predictable URL structure.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: providing user-friendly error pages.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: anonymizing/storing results non-identifiably for research.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: providing usage metrics (a single reporting feature).
